title: NSF Toothpaste Usage
body:
Nanion Lite (2%) & Nanion Elite (3%) — Chairside + Home-Use

1️⃣ Chairside Initiation Protocol (Dentist-Led)

Indications

High caries risk patients
White spot lesions (non-cavitated)
Orthodontic patients
Recurrent caries around restorations
Xerostomia / reduced salivary flow

Step 1: Baseline Assessment

• Record caries risk profile
• Identify white spot lesions (ICDAS 1–2)
• Document plaque score
• Photograph for monitoring

Step 2: Professional Cleaning

• Perform prophylaxis
• Remove plaque and biofilm
• Isolate and dry teeth gently

Step 3: Demonstration

• Apply pea-sized amount on dry brush
• Demonstrate 2-minute brushing focusing on:
→ Cervical margins
→ Interproximal areas
→ Around brackets (if present)

Step 4: No-Rinse Instruction

• Instruct patient to spit, do not rinse
• Avoid eating/drinking for 30 minutes

Step 5: Product Selection

• Nanion Lite → moderate risk
• Nanion Elite → high risk / active demineralization
2️⃣ Home-Use Guidance (Patient Instructions)
Use twice daily
Pea-sized amount
Brush 2 full minutes
Spit, do not rinse
Avoid food/drinks 30 minutes
Children 6+ only, supervised

Follow-Up

• Review at 4–6 weeks
• Reassess white spots
• Adjust risk category if required

title: White Spot Protocol
body:
Clinical management of early demineralization

Indications

ICDAS 1–2 lesions
Post-orthodontic decalcification
Early smooth surface lesions

Step 1: Diagnosis

• Dry tooth 5 seconds
• Visual exam under good illumination
• Record location and size

Step 2: Biofilm Control

• Prophylaxis
• Educate on brushing technique
• Initiate Nanion Elite (preferred)

Step 3: Targeted Application

• After brushing:
• Apply small dab directly on lesion
• Rub 30–60 seconds
• Do not rinse

Step 4: Adjunct Protocol (Optional)

• Add Nanion Swish for high-risk patients
• Consider fluoride varnish in-office (if indicated)

Monitoring (every 4–8 weeks)

• Surface hardening
• Reduced opacity
• No cavitation progression

title: Orthodontic Protocol
body:
Preventive protocol for fixed appliance patients

Risk Factors

• Plaque retention around brackets
• Reduced natural self-cleansing
• Acidogenic biofilm accumulation

Chairside Initiation

• Baseline plaque score
• Prophylaxis
• Demonstrate brushing around brackets
• Start Nanion Elite

🌅 Morning

• Brush with Nanion Elite
• Focus on gingival margin + bracket base
• Spit, no rinse

🌙 Evening

• Repeat brushing
• Use Nanion Swish (if prescribed)

Professional Maintenance

• Review every 4–6 weeks
• Reinforce hygiene
• Document demineralization status

title: Biocem Mixing & Placement
body:
Nanohybrid Biocem fold-and-press technique

Indications

Pulpotomy
Pulp capping
Apexogenesis
Furcation repair

Armamentarium

• Biocem powder & liquid
• Mixing pad
• Plastic instrument

Mixing Protocol (Fold & Press)

Dispense recommended powder scoop
Add measured liquid drops
Using spatula: Fold material inward → Press flat
Repeat 20–30 seconds
Achieve smooth, putty-like consistency

Placement

Achieve hemostasis
Place material directly over exposure
Adapt gently without pressure
Allow initial set
Place restorative material

Clinical Notes

• Moisture tolerant (avoid flooding)
• Do not over-mix
• Follow manufacturer working time

title: MARC Crown Prep & Cementation
body:
Conservative pediatric crown workflow

Indications

Multi-surface caries
Post-pulpotomy teeth
Structural loss

Tooth Preparation

• Occlusal reduction: ~1–1.5 mm
• Minimal proximal slicing
• Round sharp edges
• Maintain cervical contour

Crown Selection

• Select appropriate size
• Trial fit
• Check occlusion
• Adjust if required

Cementation Protocol

• Clean and dry tooth
• Apply luting cement
• Seat crown with finger pressure
• Remove excess cement
• Verify occlusion

Post-Operative Instructions

• Avoid sticky foods 24 hours
• Review in 1 week

title: P-Obtura Bio-Activ Obturation
body:
Pediatric endodontic handling protocol

Indications

Primary tooth pulpectomy
Infected canals in deciduous teeth

Canal Preparation

• Biomechanical preparation
• Irrigation
• Dry canals with paper points

Mixing Protocol

• Dispense powder
• Add recommended liquid ratio
• Mix to creamy consistency
• Ensure smooth homogenous blend

Placement

• Use lentulo spiral or suitable carrier
• Fill canal gradually
• Avoid over-extension
• Confirm radiographically

Final Restoration

• Restore with suitable coronal seal
• Prefer full coverage (e.g., MARC Crown) if indicated
